verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only that an API reference exists for MoQ relays (/api/resources/moq) and that Cloudflare publishes a platform-wide openapi.json. Nothing shows that the reference is interactive or includes runnable examples, such as a try-it console or executable request samples. The moq.dev publish and watch demos are media playback demos, not an API reference, so they don't transfer to this story. A static API reference link and an OpenAPI spec are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
